name: SBC
summary: SBC develops scintillating liquid-argon bubble chambers to reach dark matter near the GeV scale with lower nuclear-recoil thresholds. The Fermilab detector provides calibration, while the SNOLAB version is intended for low-background physics searches.
detection_principle: The chamber detects both bubble nucleation in a superheated noble liquid and scintillation, combining low-threshold nuclear-recoil selectivity with scintillation energy information.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
